name: citadel-risk-copilot
description: CITADEL — Risk, Fraud and Regulatory Intelligence Copilot. Exposes the CITADEL_AGENT AI gateway (natural language risk/AML/liquidity Q&A) and action tools (FILE_SAR_DRAFT, FLAG_ACCOUNT, ESCALATE_CASE) as MCP tools in CoCo Desktop. Every answer cites Basel III, FATF, FinCEN, and RBI regulatory references.
author: Avinash L — Snowflake CoCo CLI Hackathon 2026

servers.name: citadel-ai
servers.description: CITADEL AI gateway — ask questions about fraud flags, credit watch-list, LCR breaches, and regulatory obligations

servers.name: citadel-actions
servers.description: CITADEL action tools — FILE_SAR_DRAFT, FLAG_ACCOUNT, ESCALATE_CASE. Requires CITADEL_MCP_ACTION_ROLE.

setupInstructions:
Set these environment variables before connecting:
  CITADEL_READER_CLIENT_ID=<from SYSTEM$SHOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS('CITADEL_MCP_READER_OAUTH')>
  CITADEL_READER_CLIENT_SECRET=<same query>
  CITADEL_ACTION_CLIENT_ID=<from SYSTEM$SHOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS('CITADEL_MCP_ACTION_OAUTH')>
  CITADEL_ACTION_CLIENT_SECRET=<same query>

Then sign in via the OAuth flow when prompted. Your session will use CITADEL_MCP_READER_ROLE by default.
For action tools, ensure your Snowflake user has CITADEL_MCP_ACTION_ROLE granted.
